title: In Progress® Telerik® UI for Blazor versions v11.1.0 through v14.0.0, the demo application's Chat AI Integration…
description: A relative path traversal vulnerability exists in the demo application's Chat AI Integration example in In Progress® Telerik® UI for Blazor versions v11.1.0 through v14.0.0. This flaw could allow attackers to read files outside the intended chat attachments folder within the server's filesystem scope.
